settings/companionPort.title: Pairing port
settings/companionPort.body: Port this Switch listens on for pairing pushes from the companion app.

settings/pairBtn.title: Pair with companion
settings/pairBtn.body: Show a 4-digit code and wait for the desktop companion to push your PSN credentials over the network.

settings/revealCredentials.title: Reveal secrets
settings/revealCredentials.body: Unmask the stored account identifiers and authentication tokens on this page.

settings/psnOnlineId.title: Online ID
settings/psnOnlineId.body: The PSN online ID linked to your credentials.

settings/clearPsnBtn.title: Clear credentials
settings/clearPsnBtn.body: Remove access, refresh, SSO, and NPSSO tokens for the current profile. Account identifiers and console registrations remain.

settings/refreshTokenBtn.title: Refresh token
settings/refreshTokenBtn.body: Renew PSN access credentials using the stored refresh token or NPSSO data.

settings/trophiesEnabled.title: Show trophy page
settings/trophiesEnabled.body: When on, press L to view this account's trophies. Turn off to hide the trophy page entirely.
